units.text: INT. ABANDONED PLANETARIUM - NIGHT
The dome is cracked, the stars on it long gone to water stains.
A circle of folding chairs sits beneath the central projector, a bulbous metal insect.
Candle stubs flicker on the floor.
Four people sit in the circle, coats on, breath fogging.
MAGDALENA "MAGGIE" OYELOWO-SZABO is in her fifties, wrapped in a quilt, a retired astronomer's patience in her eyes.
Across from her, her adult son DAMIAN KELLERMAN-ASANTE slouches, jaw tight.
Beside him sits his wife YOLANDE BEAUMONT-DAS, tall, steady, hand on his knee.
The fourth chair holds ELIJAH "ELI" ROSENBLATT-ADEBAYO, a teenager in a hooded jacket, cradling a battered telescope case.
Thank you for coming, all of you.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: Mom, why are we here?
units.name: DAMIAN

units.text: Because the city is closing this building on Friday.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: And?
units.name: DAMIAN

units.text: And I wanted to show you the sky one more time.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: Maggie, the projector's dead.
units.name: YOLANDE

units.text: Is it?
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: She stands.
Crosses to the great machine.
Lays her palm on its flank, the way you'd greet an old horse.
She reaches into a panel, draws out a bulb the size of a fist, and screws it home.
Eli slides forward in his seat.
You fixed it?
units.name: ELI

units.text: I did, Eli. Last Tuesday.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: You came here every night this week.
units.name: DAMIAN

units.text: Every night.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: Without telling anyone.
units.name: DAMIAN

units.text: Without telling anyone, Damian.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: Silence.
Yolande squeezes her husband's knee.
He looks at the floor.
Damian. Let her.
units.name: YOLANDE

units.text: Maggie throws a switch.
The machine whirs, coughs dust, and then blooms.
On the dome, thousands of pinpoints appear, slow, shuddering, then steady.
The Milky Way rolls out across the ceiling like a shaken scarf.
Eli gasps.
Yolande puts her hand to her mouth.
Damian lifts his head, and the light spills across his face.
That's the one from the lake house.
units.name: DAMIAN

units.text: That's the one.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: You said you couldn't make it that clear again.
units.name: DAMIAN

units.text: I said a lot of things after your father died.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: Damian rises.
Walks across the circle.
Stands in front of her.
He doesn't speak.
She waits.
Then, awkwardly, like a man unused to it, he wraps his arms around her.
There now.
units.name: MAGGIE

units.text: Can I look through the scope?
units.name: ELI

units.text: Oh, Eli. There's no sky left to look through. But sit. Sit. There's plenty of dome.
units.name: MAGGIE
